policy: fail closed unless both directional relations, their composition, and semantic endpoint isolation are supported

DUOX2.reason: The source abstracts show CFTR dependence, treatment-mediated DUOX2 reduction, or correlation; they do not establish that CFTR dysfunction upregulates DUOX2.

HMGB1.reason: The retained source abstracts show modulation, a burn-confounded increase, or an award announcement; they do not establish dystrophin deficiency causing HMGB1 release.

Galectin-3.reason: DMD evidence includes Galectin-3 recruitment/upregulation but also a beneficial regenerative role; target papers are cross-disease biomarker/pathway evidence and do not establish the proposed chronic muscle-inflammation direction.
